y-m-19-12.title: Ta yaya za a karanta '2x+1/3' a taga hira?
y-m-19-12.topic: Rubutun lissafi masu canji da baka
y-m-19-12.goal: Tabbatar baka suna yanke jerin lissafi a rubutun lissafi masu canji, sannan sake rubuta maganar saƙo domin mai karatu kada ya fahimta ba daidai ba.
y-m-19-12.material: A taga hira ba za a iya rubuta kaso da layin kwance ba, don haka ana amfani da / wajen rabo. Seoyeon ta aika wa aboki saƙon: “Yankin 2x+1/3 ne.” A lissafi ana ninkawa da rabo kafin ƙari, 2x kuma samfurin 2 da x ne. (Ana karanta 2x 'biyu x'.)
y-m-19-12.thinking.0: Yanke ko haruffa iri ɗaya ana karanta su a matsayin lissafi mabambanta
y-m-19-12.thinking.1: Bincika yadda ƙima take canzawa bisa yadda aka karanta
y-m-19-12.thinking.2: Sake rubuta lissafi bisa la'akari da mai karatu
y-m-19-12.prereq.0: Rubutun ninkawa da rabo a lissafi masu canji (2x=2×x, a÷b=a/b)
y-m-19-12.s.s1.prompt: Idan x=4, menene ƙimar lissafin '2x+1/3' a saƙon idan an lissafa bisa ƙa'idar lissafi?
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.0: A lissafin saƙon, da farko nemo lissafin da ba ƙari ba ne (ninkawa, rabo) ka yi masa alama.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.1: Yi lissafin da aka yi wa alama, sannan a ƙarshe yi sauran ƙarin.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.a: Ka fara lissafa 2x=8 sannan ka ƙara 1/3. Ninkawa da rabo suna gaban ƙari.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.b: Babu baka amma ka fara ƙara x da 1. 2x ana fara lissafawa a matsayin 2×4.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.c: Ka fara ƙari sannan ka raba da 3. Rabon ya shafi 1/3 ne kawai.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.o.d: Mutum zai iya karanta shi ta hanyoyi daban-daban, don haka ba za a iya kayyade ƙima guda ba.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.d: Damuwa cewa wanda bai san ƙa'ida ba zai karanta dabam daidai ne. Duk da haka, idan aka yi amfani da ƙa'idoji, ƙimar tana kayyadewa.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.explain: 2x=2×4=8 ne, 1/3 kuma rabo ne don haka ana lissafa shi kafin ƙari. 8+1/3=25/3.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.acc.0: Bisa ƙa'ida an kayyade shi 25/3, amma damuwar cewa masu karatu za su tuna ƙa'idoji dabam abu ne mai ma'ana. Mataki na gaba, ka yi tunanin yadda za a rage damuwar.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.prompt: Akwai hanyoyi biyu na karantawa. (A) Bisa ƙa'ida: ƙimar 2x ƙara 1/3. (B) Karatun kuskure: ƙimar 2x+1 a raba da 3. Idan ka saka cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 12 a matsayin x, nemo x uku mabambanta inda bambancin ƙimomin karatun biyu ya kai 7 ko fiye. 가 나
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi wasu, kamar x=2, 6, ka lissafa ƙimomin (A) da (B) kowanne, ka rubuta su a jadawali. 가 나
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.1: A jadawali, duba yadda bambancin ƙimomin biyu ke canzawa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta x a matsayin cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Bambancin ƙimar karatun biyun ya kai 7 ko fiye.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Bambancin ƙimar karatun biyun bai kai 7 ba. Lissafa ƙimomin biyu ka nemo bambanci.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.explain: (A)−(B)=(2x+1/3)−(2x+1)/3=4x/3, don haka bambancin ya kai 7 idan x aƙalla 6 ne. Idan x=6, (A)=12 da 1/3, (B)=4 da 1/3, bambanci 8. Yayin da x ya ƙaru, bambancin ma yana ƙaruwa. 가 가 나 나
y-m-19-12.s.s3.prompt: Idan Seoyeon tana son faɗin ƙimar 2x+1 a raba da 3, ta yaya ya kamata a rubuta a layi ɗaya da haruffan madannai kawai a taga hira domin kada a sami rashin fahimta? Rubuta lissafin ka bayyana a jimla ɗaya dalilin rubuta haka.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko yanke ko abin da ake raba da 3 shi ne 2x kaɗai ko duka 2x+1.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.1: Saka x=4 cikin lissafin da ka rubuta ka bincika ko ƙimar da aka lissafa ita ce wadda kake so (3).
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika ta saka lambobi a madadin x cewa lissafin da ka rubuta, idan aka karanta bisa ƙa'ida, yana ba da ƙimar 2x+1 a raba da 3?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda abokinka zai karanta shi ka rage wuraren ruɗani?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin hanyoyin sauƙaƙa karatu ma, kamar amfani da alamar ninkawa (*)?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.0: Zan rubuta (2x+1)/3. Sanya 2x+1 cikin baka yana nuna a fili cewa duka aka raba da 3 lokaci guda, don haka babu wanda zai karanta dabam.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.1: Rubuta kamar (2*x+1)/3 ka saka baka domin kada jerin lissafi ya rikice. Haka kuma yi amfani da alamar ninkawa * domin a gane 2 da x dabam ne.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.modelNote.1: Rubutun aminci da ya haɗa alamar ninkawa ma

y-m-19-06.title: Idan zafin jiki ya bambanta da 7℃, mene ne kuma muke buƙatar sani?
y-m-19-06.topic: Ƙara da rage lambobin da ba su da kyau (ma'anar bambanci)

y-m-19-06.material: Wata rana, zafin jiki da ƙarfe 9 na safe ya kasance −3℃ (digiri 3 ƙasa da sifili). An ce zafin jiki da ƙarfe 3 na yamma ya bambanta da na ƙarfe 9 na safe da 7℃. y-m-19-06.thinking.2: Faɗi takamaiman ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata

y-m-19-06.s.s1.hint.0: Alama −3 a layin lambobi, ka ƙirga wurare nawa ne suke da matakai 7 daga gare shi.

y-m-19-06.s.s1.explain: Matakai 7 zuwa dama daga −3 su ne 4℃, matakai 7 zuwa hagu kuma −10℃ ne. Duk ƙimomin biyu suna da bambanci 7℃.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.prompt: Wane ƙarin bayani kake buƙatar sani don tantance zafin ƙarfe 3 na yamma a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya? Zaɓi duk abin da saninsa kaɗai zai tantance ta.

y-m-19-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, ka duba: ‘Idan na san wannan bayanin, zan iya bambance 4 da −10?’

y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.a: Sanin tsawon lokacin da ya wuce ba ya gaya maka ko zafin jikin ya tashi ko ya sauka.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.b: Ko zafin ƙarfe 3 na yamma ya fi na ƙarfe 9 na safe zafi ko ya fi sanyi
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.b: Wannan bayani ne da ke tantance ko za a matsa dama ko hagu daga −3. Yana zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin biyun.

y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.d: Ko ƙimar da aka bayar daidai ce ba shi da alaƙa da dalilin da ya sa ƙimar ta kasu kashi biyu a wannan matsalar.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.explain: Idan ka san ‘ya fi zafi’ ko ‘ya fi 0℃’, za a tantance shi a matsayin 4℃ ko −10℃. Yawan sa'o'in da suka wuce ko ko ƙimar da aka riga aka bayar daidai ce ba ya taimakawa.

y-m-19-04.title: Nemo lambar da za a ninka 72 da ita domin samun murabba'in wata lamba
y-m-19-04.topic: Ninkawa domin samun lambar murabba'i (adadin abubuwan farko)
y-m-19-04.goal: Nemo lambobi da dama, ba ɗaya kawai ba, waɗanda idan aka ninka da su za su samar da murabba'i, sannan ka bayyana da kalmomi ƙa'idar da suke da ita tare.
y-m-19-04.material: Muna son ninka 72 da cikakkiyar lamba a domin samfurin ya zama murabba'in cikakkiyar lamba (lambar da aka samu ta ninka lamba ɗaya da kanta). Misali, kamar ninka 12 da 3 domin 12×3=36=6×6. Ka yi la'akari da a daga 1 zuwa 100 kawai.
y-m-19-04.thinking.0: Samar da mafita da dama masu cika iyakoki
y-m-19-04.thinking.1: Nemo ƙa'idar gama-gari tsakanin mafita da dama
y-m-19-04.thinking.2: Bayyana dangantakar mafita mafi ƙarami da sauran
y-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙaramin cikakkiyar lamba a ce idan an ninka ta da 72 za a samu murabba'in lamba?
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka rubuta murabba'in lambobin da ke kusa da 72, wato 64 da 81, ka duba ko 72 murabba'in lamba ce.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka rubuta 72 a matsayin ninkin lambobi biyu, 8×9, ka duba wanne daga cikinsu ya riga ya zama murabba'in wata lamba.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.a: Da farko ka duba ko 72 da kanta murabba'in lamba ce. 72 yana tsakanin 8×8=64 da 9×9=81, saboda haka ba murabba'in lamba ba ne.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.b: A cikin 72=2×2×2×3×3, an haɗa 3s bibbiyu, saura 2 guda ɗaya. Idan aka ninka da wani 2 guda ɗaya, dukkan abubuwan za su zama a haɗe bibbiyu.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.c: 72×3=216. Yana tsakanin 14×14=196 da 15×15=225, saboda haka ba murabba'in lamba ba ne. Ninkawa da 3 yana ƙara 3 guda uku, wanda a zahiri ke karya haɗin bibbiyun.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.d: 72×8=576=24×24, saboda haka gaskiya ne ya zama murabba'in lamba. Amma ba ka duba ko wata ƙaramin lamba ma za ta yi aiki ba.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Idan ka rubuta 72 a matsayin 2×2×2×3×3, an haɗa 3s bibbiyu, saura 2 guda ɗaya. Ninkawa da 2 zai ba da 2×2×2×2×3×3 = (2×2×3)×(2×2×3) = 12×12. 1 ba ya aiki, don haka ƙaramin lamba ita ce 2.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Nemo lambobi a guda 3 daban-daban da idan an ninka su da 72 za a samu murabba'in lamba. (Cikakkun lambobi daga 1 zuwa 100)
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fara daga ƙaramin lamba, 2, ka gwada ko ninka 72 da 2 da wasu lambobi zai ci gaba da ba da murabba'in lambobi.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka rubuta kowane ninkin da ka samu a matsayin ninkin lambobi biyu iri ɗaya don tabbatarwa.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.var.a: Lambar a da za a ninka 72 da ita
y-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ka rubuta a a matsayin cikakkiyar lamba.

y-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka jera a ɗin da ka samu daga ƙarami, wane tsari iri ɗaya ka lura da shi? Ka rubuta ƙa'idar da kalmominka.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka rubuta kowane a da ka samu a matsayin 2×(wata lamba), sannan ka jera lambobin cikin baka a jere.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka jera lambobin da suka bayyana cikin baka daga ƙarami, sannan ka rubuta kowane a matsayin ninkin lambobi.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka duba ko ƙa'idar da ka rubuta tana aiki ga a ɗin da ba ka samo ba tukuna (misali, 72, 98)?
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana ‘dalilin da ya sa dole a haɗa 2’ ta hanyar danganta shi da yadda aka rubuta 72 a matsayin ninkin lambobi?

y-m-19-02.title: Ta yaya za mu amince da ƙimar (−1)×(−2)?
y-m-19-02.topic: Ninkawa da lambobi marasa kyau da dalilan ƙa'idar
y-m-19-02.goal: Bambanta yadda hujjoji iri dabam (tsari, ka'idar rarrabawa, fassarar rayuwa ta zahiri) ke goyon bayan ƙarshe (mara kyau)×(mara kyau)=mai kyau, sannan ka daidaita tabbacin ka yayin da bayanai suke ƙaruwa.
y-m-19-02.material: A ce ka riga ka san ninkawa (mai kyau)×(mara kyau) ga ninkawar cikakkun lambobi. Ana karanta (−2) 'debe biyu', (−1)×(−2) kuma 'debe ɗaya ninki debe biyu'. Mu duba yadda tunaninka kan ƙimar (−1)×(−2) yake canzawa yayin da aka ba da bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-19-02.thinking.0: Hasashen ƙima ta gaba daga tsari
y-m-19-02.thinking.1: Duba yadda sabon bayani yake canza tabbaci
y-m-19-02.prereq.0: Ninkawa da lamba mai kyau da mara kyau (misali 3×(−2)=−6)
y-m-19-02.prereq.1: Gwajin lissafin samfurin da ke da jimilla cikin baka (ka'idar rarrabawa) da cikakkun lambobi
y-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci zaɓi abin da ya fi yiwuwa yanzu, sannan ka gwada tunaninka da bayani na gaba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, bambanta ko abin da ka koya 'yana ƙarfafa tsammaninka' ko 'yana sa ka yi tunanin zangon tsammaninka'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Saka amsar da ka zaɓa kai tsaye cikin lissafi ka duba ko ta saɓa wa bayanin baya.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.info:
Na rubuta ƙimomin ninkawa da (−2) yayin da ninkawa ke raguwa ta 3, 2, 1, 0.

2×(−2)=−4
1×(−2)=−2

y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Duba yadda sakamako yake canzawa duk lokacin da mai ninkawa a jadawali ya ragu da 1, ka yi hasashen ƙimar layi na gaba, (−1)×(−2).
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ci gaba da tsarin ka yi hasashen 2 abu ne mai ma'ana, kuma son ƙarin dubawa ma ya dace domin babu tabbacin tsarin zai ci gaba. Tsari hujja ce kawai, ba tabbatarwa ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 2. Sakamako yana ƙaruwa da 2 kowane lokaci, saboda haka na gaba ma 2 ne.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hasashe ne da aka yi ta ci gaba da tsarin jadawali zuwa ƙwaya ta gaba. Ya ɗauka tsarin zai ci gaba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: −2. Ana ninkawa da lamba mara kyau, saboda haka sakamakon ma mara kyau ne.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ya yi amfani da jin alamomi kawai: 'akwai lamba mara kyau, don haka amsar mara kyau ce'. Bai yi amfani da yadda sakamakon jadawali ke canzawa ba tukuna.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ban sani ba tukuna. Ina buƙatar bincika dabam ko tsarin zai ci gaba a wuraren lambobi marasa kyau.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hali ne na amfani da tsarin a matsayin hujja yayin la'akari da zangonsa. Tsari ba ya tabbatar da ci gaba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: 0. Ba zai yi ƙasa da 0 ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan ya ɗauka 0 ne 'ƙarshe'. Jadawali bai bayar da dalilin tsayawa a 0 ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.info:
Sabon bayani: A ce ka'idar rarrabawa da ka yi amfani da ita da cikakkun lambobi (ninka jimillar cikin baka iri ɗaya ne da ninka kowane sashe sannan a haɗa) tana ci gaba da aiki ga lambobi marasa kyau ma. To
(−1)×(−2)+1×(−2)=((−1)+1)×(−2)=0×(−2)=0
kuma 1×(−2)=−2.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bayan ganin wannan bayani, ta yaya tunaninka game da (−1)×(−2) ya canza?
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Yana da ma'ana ka riƙe hasashenka na farko (2) ka ƙara tabbaci, kuma yana da ma'ana ka nuna cewa ƙarshe yana dogara da alƙawarin 'ka'idar rarrabawa tana ci gaba da aiki'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 0. Sakamakon lissafin sama 0 ne, saboda haka ƙimar (−1)×(−2) dole ta zama 0 ma.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki ƙimar jimillar lissafin 0 a matsayin ƙimar kalma ɗaya cikinsa. Wannan kalma ita ce lambar da aka ƙara wa −2 don jimilla ta zama 0.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Canza zuwa −2. Idan kalmomin biyu −2 ne, lissafin zai yi kyau da tsari.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: (−2)+(−2)=−4, saboda haka jimillar ba 0 ba ce. An manta da saka ta cikin lissafi a duba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: An ƙayyade 2 ƙarƙashin alƙawarin cewa ka'idar rarrabawa tana ci gaba da aiki. Idan alƙawarin ya canza, ƙimar na iya bambanta.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan ma ya duba zato da ƙarshe ya dogara da shi. Hukunci ne mai lura da zangon da ƙa'ida take aiki.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Na fi tabbata 2 ne. Domin jimilla ta zama 0 da −2, dole a sami akasin −2.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Sabon bayani ya ƙarfafa hasashenka na farko. Ka yanke ƙimar ta sharadin cewa ita ce lambar da idan aka ƙara ta jimillar ta zama 0.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Sabon bayani: Jaemin ya ce, “Ban fahimci ma'anar bashi 2원 ninki −1 ba. Idan ba za a iya bayyana shi a zahiri ba, ba zan iya yarda cewa (−1)×(−2)=2 ba.” A gefe guda, ana iya fassara ninkawar a matsayin '−2 yana matakai 2 hagu, ninkawa da −1 kuma yana juya alkibla'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me kake tunani game da ra'ayin Jaemin?
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Yana da ma'ana kada a ƙi ƙa'ida saboda babu misali na rayuwa, a bambanta matsayin daidaiton ƙa'ida da fassara.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Rashin bayanin rayuwa ta zahiri ba ya sa ta zama kuskure. Ina bincika ko ta saɓa wa sauran ƙa'idoji.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka gano dalilin karɓar ƙarshe ba daga misalin rayuwa guda ba, sai daga daidaiton tsarin ƙa'idodi gaba ɗaya.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akwai ƙa'ida da fassara (juya alkibla), don haka na karɓa, amma na tuna fassarar kwatanci ce kawai.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka bambanta matsayin ƙa'ida da kwatanci. Ka ɗauki fassara a matsayin taimako, ba tushen dalili gaba ɗaya ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Idan akwai ko hanya ɗaya ta fassara ta zahiri, an tabbatar da sakamakon gaba ɗaya.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Fassara tana taimakawa fahimta, amma fassara ɗaya ba hujja ba ce. Dole ne kuma ta kasance ba ta saɓa wa ƙa'idoji.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Dole a ɗauki ƙa'idar da ba za a iya bayyana da misalin rayuwa nan take ba a matsayin ƙa'ida marar daidai.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ba kowace ƙa'idar lissafi za a iya bayyana da misalin rayuwa nan take ba. Rashin fassara ba ya sa ƙa'ida ta zama ba daidai ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.reflect: Tsarin lambobi hujja ce cewa 'kamar zai ci gaba', ka'idar rarrabawa dalili ce cewa 'idan aka kiyaye alƙawarin, haka aka kayyade', fassarar rayuwa kuma 'kwatanci ne da ke taimakawa fahimta'. Ka waiwayi yadda tabbacin ka game da ƙarshe ɗaya ya canza yayin da tushen dalili ya bambanta.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana son bayyana wa aboki cewa (−3)×(−2)=6. Zaɓi duk abin da za a iya amfani da shi a matsayin dalili.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi sake tambaya 'to me ya sa?' ka duba ko amsa tana ci gaba.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada bayanin kowane zaɓi yadda yake ga wasu yanayi kamar (−3)×(−3) ko (−2)×(−2), ka bincika ko yana aiki.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ya yanke ƙimar ta amfani da ka'idar rarrabawa da ninkawa da aka sani kawai. Dalili ne da aka samo daga ƙa'idojin baya ba tare da sabon alƙawari ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.o.b: Na shigar da shi kalkuleta, ƙimar 6 ta fito, kuma iri ɗaya ce ko sau nawa na danna, saboda haka lissafin daidai ne.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.r.b: Kalkuleta ma an gina ta bisa ƙa'idoji ɗaya. Tana nuna sakamako ne kawai ba ta bayyana dalili ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.o.c: Idan akwai alamomin debe biyu suna soke juna, samfurin ya zama mai kyau, wannan shi ne dalili.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.r.c: Kwatanci ne mai sauƙin tunawa amma ba dalili ba ne. Ba zai iya bayyana abin da ke faruwa da alamomin debe uku ba.
y-m-19-02.s.s2.o.d: Idan aka rage mai ninkawa ta 3, 2, 1, … sakamakon yana ƙaruwa da 2 kowane lokaci, tsarin kuma yana ci gaba har zuwa (−3)×(−2).

y-m-19-07.title: Kwatanta hanyoyin gano tsakiyar lambobi biyu a kan layin lambobi

y-m-19-07.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi daban-daban na gano tsakiyar don bambance hanyoyin da suka dace da fahimtar kuskure, sannan ka samar da nau'i-nau'i da dama na lambobi masu tsakiya iri ɗaya.
y-m-19-07.material: A kan layin lambobi, aya A tana a −7 (mara kyau bakwai), aya B kuma tana a 5. Mutane huɗu sun bayyana hanyoyi daban-daban na gano matsayin aya M, tsakiyar A da B. (Tazara tsakanin A da B ita ce 5−(−7)=12.)

y-m-19-07.s.s1.o.b: Jisu: Tara lambobin biyu ka raba da 2. (−7+5)÷2 = −1
y-m-19-07.s.s1.r.b: An yi amfani da ra'ayin cewa matsakaicin lambobi biyu shi ne tsakiyarsu. Muhimmin abu shi ne an riƙe alamomin yayin tarawa.

y-m-19-07.s.s1.r.c: 6 tazara ce daga A zuwa M. Don samun matsayi, dole ne a matsa wannan tazara daga wurin farawa.
y-m-19-07.s.s1.o.d: Hayun: Matsa rabin tazara 12, wato 6, zuwa dama daga A. −7+6 = −1

y-m-19-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ukur jarak ti nilai nu kapanggih ku cara tadi ka unggal dua titik, tuluy pariksa naha jarakna sarua.

y-m-19-08.title: Nguji klaim “hasil ngabagi ogé sarua lamun urutanana dibalik”
y-m-19-08.topic: Ngabagi angka bulat jeung hukum komutatif

y-m-19-09.s.s1.prompt: Pilih sakabéh pasangan tina opat pasangan di handap nu dua ekspresina salawasna sarua nilaina, sabaraha waé angka nu diasupkeun pikeun x.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.hint.0: Dina unggal pasangan, asupkeun 0 jeung 1 pikeun x, tuluy bandingkeun nilaina.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.hint.1: Pikeun pasangan nu nilaina béda, hiji uji geus cukup pikeun nyaho yén ekspresina béda. Lamun nilaina sarua, cobaan angka séjén atawa miceun kurung pikeun mariksa.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.a: Miceun kurung ngahasilkeun 3x−6+5, tuluy ngagabungkeun konstanta ngahasilkeun 3x−1. Dua ekspresi éta sarua.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.b: Ngali 2 ka unggal suku dina kurung ngahasilkeun 2x+2, tuluy jumlahna 3x+2. Béda dina hiji bagian, nyaéta suku konstanta.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.c: Ngali −2 ka x jeung −3 ngahasilkeun −2x+6, jadi 4x−2x+6 = 2x+6. Dua ekspresi éta sarua.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.d: Tanda − di hareupeun kurung mangaruhan duanana suku di jero. Hasilna −x+4, jadi jumlahna x+4, tanda suku konstantana béda ti x−4.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.explain: Pikeun a jeung c, sanggeus kurung dipiceun ekspresina sarua. Pikeun b, 2x+2+x = 3x+2, sarta pikeun d, −x+4+2x = x+4, jadi suku konstanta béda jeung ekspresina henteu sarua.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.prompt: Aya ekspresi A = 3x+2. Lamun x=2, nilai A nyaéta 8. Jieun tilu ekspresi linear béda B = px+q nu nilaina 8 nalika x=2 tapi lain ekspresi nu sarua jeung A. (p jeung q angka bulat ti −10 nepi ka 10)
y-m-19-09.s.s2.hint.0: Pilih heula nilai p, tuluy saluyukeun q supaya lamun x=2 hasilna 8.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.hint.1: Pariksa ogé naon nu kajadian lamun p dijieun 3.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c1: p jeung q téh angka bulat ti −10 nepi ka 10.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Tulis p jeung q minangka angka bulat ti −10 nepi ka 10.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Nilai B nalika x=2 lain 8. Itung 2×p+q.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Koéfisiénna béda ti milik A, jadi éta lain ekspresi nu sarua.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Lamun p=3, mangka q=2 sarta éta ekspresi nu sarua jeung A. Jieun nu béda.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c4: Koéfisién x lain 0, jadi ieu ekspresi linear.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c4: Lamun p=0, ieu konstanta, jadi lain ekspresi linear.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.explain: Ekspresi nu nilaina 8 nalika x=2 di antarana B = x+6, 2x+4, 4x+0, 5x−2. Kabéh sarua jeung A ngan nalika x=2; contona nalika x=0, A nilaina 2 sedengkeun B = x+6 nilaina 6.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.prompt: Kusabab nilai dua ekspresi sarua nalika x=2, naha bisa disebut ekspresi nu sarua? Lamun henteu, tulis alesanana sarta tulis ogé naon nu kudu dipigawé pikeun némbongkeun yén dua ekspresi béda.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.hint.0: Pilih salah sahiji ekspresi nu dijieun dina léngkah saméméhna, tuluy bandingkeun nilaina nalika x=2 jeung x=0.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.hint.1: Pikirkeun sabaraha nilai nu kudu diuji pikeun nyebut “ieu ekspresi nu sarua”.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.placeholder: Conto: Ngan sarua dina hiji nilai, jadi ...
y-m-19-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngabédakeun ku kecap sorangan antara “nilaina sarua” jeung “ekspresina sarua”?
y-m-19-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun nyebutkeun yén pikeun ngabuktikeun dua ekspresi béda, cukup néangan hiji kasus nu nilaina béda?
y-m-19-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ogé mikirkeun naon nu kudu dipigawé pikeun ngabuktikeun yén dua ekspresi sarua?
y-m-19-09.s.s3.model.0: Éta ngan sarua dina hiji nilai, nyaéta x=2. Lamun diasupkeun nilai séjén, contona x=0, tuluy némbongkeun hiji kasus nilaina béda, saperti A nilaina 2 jeung B nilaina 6, dua ekspresi éta béda.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.model.1: Nilai nu sarua sakali henteu hartina salawasna sarua. 3x+2 jeung 2x+4 duanana nilaina 8 ngan nalika x=2. Lamun diasupkeun angka séjén sanajan hiji sarta nilaina béda, ekspresina béda.
